title: Virtual Cell Challenge 2026: Benchmarking zero-shot generalization across cellular contexts.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed the public bucket gs://arc-institute-virtual-cell-atlas/virtual-cell-challenge/ through the Google Cloud Storage JSON API: it holds only a 2025/ folder (adata_Training.h5ad 15.5 GB, adata_Validation.h5ad 6.9 GB, adata_Test.h5ad 12.0 GB, plus FASTQ files of tens of GB each), and a 2026/ prefix returns nothing. Downloaded the 2025 pert_counts_Training.csv (150 target genes, columns target_gene, n_cells, median_umi_per_cell) and pert_counts_Test.csv (100 genes). The virtualcellchallenge.org/datasets page is rendered by JavaScript and returned no content.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: No full text (paywalled, no PMCID); I only had the abstract. From Arc Institute news pages: six cell lines, anonymized as contexts A–C (validation) and D–F (final test); for each target context only non-targeting control cells are released (18,400 per context) plus 300 knockdown gene names; the perturbed ground truth is withheld until scoring; the data sits in a new Requester Pays Google Cloud bucket that needs a Marketplace-subscribed project; test set released 22 Oct 2026; over 30 million cells and more than 10,000 perturbations per line generated in total.

a1_downloadable.note: The 2026 data needs challenge registration plus a Google Cloud project subscribed on Marketplace (Requester Pays bucket), and the 2026 folder is not in the public bucket (checked the listing). The perturbed-cell responses, which are the labels, are withheld until scoring. The page text is the source for the access terms.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: For the 2026 contexts only control cells and target gene names are released; the knockdown response, which is what we'd predict, isn't public (per Arc's announcement, not checked in files).

a3_inputs_present.note: Control-cell expression and target gene symbols are the inputs (paper/announcement only).

a4_units_stated.note: Raw UMI counts in AnnData h5ad, judging by the 2025 release format; not opened for 2026.

a5_enough_rows.note: Unknown. The labelled unit is a perturbation-context pair (300 genes × 3 contexts per round), but none of these labels are public yet.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: 2025 analogue: 15.5 GB training h5ad (checked size); 2026 size unknown
a6_fits_laptop.note: Cell-level files are far over 5 GB; pseudobulk tables would fit, but none are published for 2026.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not check: no 2026 files accessible.

a8_label_provenance.note: The labels would be measured CRISPRi Perturb-seq responses (gene knockdown followed by single-cell RNA sequencing), not model output; announcement only.

existing_models.name: BioMap xTrimoSCPerturb (2025 challenge winner; scFoundation backbone plus statistical baseline features)
existing_models.score_and_split: First place on the 2025 held-out test perturbations in H1 stem cells (one cell line); exact metric values not retrieved.
existing_models.authors_named_unsolved: Arc's wrap-up: models did not consistently beat naive baselines on all metrics; pure end-to-end learning hasn't solved it.

existing_models.name: Altos Labs flow-matching model (2025 Generalist Prize)
existing_models.score_and_split: Generalist Prize on the 2025 test set; pretrained on about 7 million public single cells; numbers not retrieved.
existing_models.authors_named_unsolved: Generalization to unseen cell contexts, which is the stated motivation for the 2026 round.

backbone.name: scGPT or Geneformer (single-cell foundation models)
backbone.hardware: CPU for embedding pseudobulk controls; cell-level work needs a GPU
backbone.licence: Data licence not stated on pages retrieved

integration.partner_dataset: Replogle et al. genome-wide Perturb-seq in K562/RPE1 cell lines (public)
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Do knockdown effects learned in a few cell lines transfer to unseen tissue contexts? This is the challenge itself, and its labels aren't public.

controls.positive_control: Knockdown of the target gene itself should lower its own expression (on-target effect).
controls.negative_control: Non-targeting guide cells and a predict-the-control-mean dummy.
controls.external_validation: None available until Arc releases the 2026 ground truth.

honest_claim_h3: Until the 2026 ground truth is released, no claim is testable offline; at best we could submit to a leaderboard covering three anonymized cell lines and 300 knockdowns each.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the resting gene expression of an unseen cell line, plus the name of a silenced gene, to predict how every gene's expression changes.
plain_idea.train_on: Public gene knockdown screens in other cell lines, plus control-cell profiles from the new lines; number of labelled examples for the new lines: unknown (withheld).
plain_idea.predict: Per-gene expression change after CRISPRi knockdown (gene silencing), measured by single-cell RNA sequencing in Arc's 2026 screen.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Groups building 'virtual cell' models would learn whether knockdown effects transfer across tissues, but that answer depends on labels Arc is holding back.

more_or_better_data.why: We'd get the same released data as 1,000+ competing teams, and the labels are hidden.

confidence_score.why: Without released perturbed cells there are no replicates to estimate noise for the new contexts.

models_beatable.why: The 2025 winners did not consistently beat naive baselines (Arc wrap-up), but hundreds of well-resourced teams compete in 2026.

guaranteed_improvement.why: The 2025 winners' weights weren't confirmed open, and the 2026 evaluation labels aren't accessible.

ml_idea: Zero-shot prediction of CRISPRi knockdown expression responses in unseen cell lines from their control profiles; not feasible offline until the ground truth is released.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: 2026 data not accessible; the 2025 cell-level h5ad files are 7–15 GB each (checked sizes).
effort.cheapest_killing_check: After the challenge ends, check whether Arc posts the 2026 perturbed-cell ground truth in the public, non-Requester-Pays bucket.

verdict_reason: A1/A2 fail. The 2026 knockdown responses (the labels) are withheld for the competition, and the released controls sit behind registration and a Requester Pays Google Cloud Marketplace bucket. The public 2025 data is a different single-cell-line release that the 2025 challenge already modelled heavily. Re-check once the ground truth is published after November 2026.
